artifacts.notes: Visual survey bounded to exact PDF pages 1–8 and 224–239; title and approval leaves identified in the edition notes were examined in page rasters made by the repository pdf-review renderer. This is a front-matter identity check, not complete page inspection or full-text collation. PDF page order is the provider’s order and differs from printed page numbering and right-to-left reading order.
